reviewed_contract.terminal_gate: Requires the explicitly supplied SHA-256 of workflow-linkage-bridge-execution-review.json; the approval binds this supervisor and runner, and a stage-local terminal record binds the exact qualification result path and SHA-256.
reviewed_contract.qualification_status: Requires the exact campaign assessment/source and correctness_failed terminal status; it does not require successful qualification.
reviewed_contract.campaign_cleanup: Requires terminal cleanup_verified, proxy_restored, and source_unchanged evidence.
reviewed_contract.child_protocol: A successful supervisor result requires no protocol issue, both started and terminal records, and an identical temporary_directory in both records.
reviewed_contract.source_integrity: Rehashes source after the child exits and fails closed on a changed or unavailable digest.
reviewed_contract.process_cleanup: Uses one monotonic parent deadline and exact PID/create_time checks; pre-cleanup observation failures still enter escalation, and cleanup drains without invoking the record writer.
reviewed_contract.limitations: Observed-process cleanup is not proof of complete containment; polling cannot detect every detached or missed child, and sampled temporary-tree size is not a filesystem quota.
